properties.title: Example data: 2026 norms and NUAR at Ledreborg
properties.description: Data for the SemanticGIS example comparing the 2026 nitrogen norms with NUAR (2027) at Ledreborg Gods, Lejre (Agriculture), frozen as they were used.

semanticgis:sources.name: Marker 2024–2026, Jordbundskort 2024, Kvælstofretention UMR 2027: Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø
text: Free public data, fetched 12 November 2026; Marker 2026 is preliminary.
Attribution: Indeholder data fra Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø, hentet 12. november 2026

semanticgis:sources.name: Jordartskort 1:25 000: GEUS
text: Version 7.1, January 2026. Attribution: Indeholder data fra GEUS, Jordartskort 1:25 000

semanticgis:sources.name: Kulstof 2022 and DJF_LAVBUND: via Danmarks Miljøportal
DMI 10 km climate grid
text: dmidk/Climate-Data-Grid-Map; the NUAR cell numbering is inferred (see the nuar code).

semanticgis:sources.name: Model: NUAR-regneark v1.3 (SEGES Innovation / Aarhus University), via https://github.com/Esbern/nuar
text: A preliminary tool; the final regulation may differ. The tables of the workbook are not included.

semanticgis:sources.name: Landscapes
text: Digitised for the example by Esbern Holmes, Roskilde University.

vectors.title: Field pieces with NUAR inputs and results, and landscapes (GeoPackage)
vectors.description: Marker 2024–2026 flattened (2 m) within the landscapes; pieces of at least 0.05 ha with a crop in all three years. Results from NUAR-regneark v1.3 (SEGES/Aarhus University) through the nuar code, for two catch-crop scenarios.

table:columns.name: landscape
table:columns.description: the landscape the piece lies in (largest share)

table:columns.name: y2024_Afgkode
table:columns.description: crop code 2024

table:columns.name: y2025_Afgkode
table:columns.description: crop code 2025

table:columns.name: y2026_Afgkode
table:columns.description: crop code 2026 (preliminary)

table:columns.name: jb
table:columns.description: JB number from Jordbundskort 2024, the one covering the largest share

table:columns.name: jb_share
table:columns.description: that share of the piece

table:columns.name: c_horizon
table:columns.description: subsoil as NUAR names it

table:columns.name: geus_jordart
table:columns.description: GEUS Jordartskort 1:25 000 symbol at a point inside the piece

table:columns.name: subsoil_note
table:columns.description: where the subsoil was set to the nearest NUAR type, or to Moræneler

table:columns.name: lowland
table:columns.description: NUAR lowland class (Kulstof 2022 > 12 % peat: organogen; Kulstof 2022 or DJF_LAVBUND: minerogen; more than half the piece)

table:columns.name: retention_pct
table:columns.description: N retention towards the coast, %, largest share (Kvælstofretention UMR 2027)

table:columns.name: grid
table:columns.description: DMI 10 km climate cell

table:columns.name: prev_cover_A
table:columns.description: cover after the 2025 crop, A

table:columns.name: cover_A

table:columns.name: discharge_A

table:columns.name: nuar_class_A
